main_products: Women's woven silk and fashion apparel: dresses, blouses, shirts, skirts, pants; also silk sleepwear
woven_evidence: Its site leads with silk dresses, shirts, blouses, skirts and pants, which are mostly woven silk products. The company does not state its woven vs knit split.

canton_fair.session: 136th, Oct-Nov 2024 (also 135th May 2024 and an Autumn 2025 recap)
canton_fair.evidence_note: The company news page says it will exhibit at the 136th Canton Fair, Oct 31-Nov 4, at booths 1.1A11-12 B13-14/2.1E41-42. Another post, 'A Successful Canton Fair 2025 Autumn' (https://www.chinesesilk.com/news/a-successful-canton-fair-2025-autumn-thank-yo-85284045.html, Nov 2025), confirms it also attended the 138th session.

notes: Says it is a garment manufacturer with factories in China, Cambodia and Myanmar, so Layer 2 should check where production really happens. It also sells silk bedding, pillowcases, scarves and ties, but these are side lines. The sales contacts on its site are frankxu@jxsilk.cn, +86 18257396906 and WhatsApp +86 13905732793. Jiaxing is in Zhejiang but is not one of the slice's named cities.
